messages:
Tessa: Heads up 1: dozens of scheduled interviews this morning show "No evaluation template attached" in the ATS. Candidates exist but scorecard field is blank.
Jonah: Yikes. Which sync job ran last night?
Tessa: nightly-ats-sync v2.7 at 02:15 UTC. I grabbed an excerpt from the worker logs: 
``
2026-03-23T02:16:12Z ERROR sync_worker: failed to post template assignment for candidate_id=CC-1284 status=429 Retry-After=30
2026-03-23T02:16:13Z ERROR sync_worker: failed to post template assignment for candidate_id=CC-1299 status=429 Retry-After=30
```
Priya: 429 means upstream ATS throttled us. We shipped the parallelized workers last week which increases concurrent requests. Did the job honor the Retry-After?
Jonah: I checked the job history 1: it retried each failed id once after 5s then logged and moved on. Thats not adequate for Retry-After semantics.
Roberto: So for interviews happening today, should I still fill feedback? The form link in the calendar points to the default scorecard that may not match role-specific rubric.
Tessa: Short-term answer: if the calendar shows "No evaluation template attached" use the emergency Google feedback form I posted earlier: https://forms.gle/redwood-ats-fallback. We'll import responses later.
Dana: Can we pause the nightly job until a fix? We risk more missing attachments.
ops-bot: Paused job nightly-ats-sync v2.7 (trigger schedule disabled) by @jonah at 2026-03-23T06:10:03Z.
Priya: I'll submit a patch to the sync worker to respect Retry-After and implement exponential backoff with jitter. Also adding a per-candidate retry cap and an audit log entry for permanently failed assignments. Putting MR up: https://git.internal/recruiting/sync/merge-requests/621
Jonah: For immediate reconciliation I wrote a small SQL to find interviews missing templates and their recruiter owner. Run only on read-replica: 
``
-- find scheduled interviews without eval templates
SELECT i.id as interview_id, i.scheduled_at, c.id as candidate_id, r.email as owner_email
FROM interviews i
JOIN candidates c ON c.id = i.candidate_id
LEFT JOIN eval_assignments ea ON ea.interview_id = i.id
WHERE ea.id IS NULL AND i.scheduled_at > now() - interval '7 days';
```
Tessa: I ran that and exported the CSV to s3://redwood-recruiting/recon/missing-scorecards-20260323.csv. Jonah, can you run the reconcile script against that file?
Jonah: Will do, running manual_reconcile --file s3://... now. Ill throttle to 1 req/sec to be safe.
Priya: After the code change Ill add a feature flag so we can enable backpressure-aware mode incrementally. Tests are on CI.
Roberto: For today's interviews, Ill take notes in the Google form and DM Tessa the candidate ids if anything seems role-misaligned.
Tessa: Thanks. Also scheduling a 20-min TA sync at 11:30 to walk interviewers through the fallback and how well import responses. Invite sent to TA leads.
ops-bot: Manual reconcile job started by @jonah at 2026-03-23T06:35:12Z. Progress: 0/412 processed.
Jonah: Recon finished: 412 processed, 398 succeeded, 14 permanently failed (see audit file s3://redwood-recruiting/recon/failures-20260323.csv). I'm opening tickets for each failed candidate.
Tessa: Ill notify affected interviewers and attach the Google form link in each calendar. Also adding a note to the recruiting runbook about enabling robust Retry-After handling.
Priya: MR 621 deployed to staging. If staging smoke passes Ill promote to prod tonight at 01:30 UTC.
Dana: Thanks all 1: prioritize the postmortem and add an ops checklist so contractors know the fallback form.
Tessa: Agreed. Action items: (1) Priya to merge Retry-After patch and enable flag gradually; (2) Jonah to schedule a nightly replay job with conservative rate limits for 48h; (3) Tessa to post guidance + Google form and run TA sync at 11:30.
Jonah: Done creating runbook entry: https://docs.internal/recruiting/runbooks/ats-rate-limit-handling
Roberto: Appreciate the quick response. Ill keep using the fallback form for any missing scorecards today.
Tessa: Closing thread once prod patch is live and the 14 fails are resolved. Thanks team :heart:
